pages.text: Smelt an iron ingot to get a $(item)Heated Ingot$(). A blast furnace is twice as fast.

Finer metal takes longer: heating an ingot takes 30 seconds more for each ★ it's aiming for past the first (15 in a blast furnace). Iron heats in 5 seconds; a Tempered Ingot ★4, aiming for ★5, takes 2 minutes 5 seconds.
pages.title: Heating Time

pages.text: Metal starts cooling once it leaves the furnace: orange, then red, then faded red, then cold. You have about 30 seconds to work it (longer as your Forging improves). Cooler metal is harder to strike: the marker sweeps faster. Cold metal goes back in the furnace with no loss.
pages.title: Cooling
